findings.statement: Baseline TNFa pathway activity is higher in non-responders to ustekinumab (BH padj [type=response_pathway; source=ANALYSIS:treatment; arms.ustekinumab.padj=0.0000484]), and also in infliximab, golimumab, vedolizumab and UNIFI placebo, so it is a general severity signal rather than drug-specific; the PURSUIT placebo arm does not show it (padj [type=response_pathway; source=ANALYSIS:treatment; arms.placebo (PURSUIT).padj=0.932]).

NFkB activity is higher at baseline in non-responders to infliximab (BH padj [type=response_pathway; source=ANALYSIS:treatment; arms.infliximab.padj=0.000294]) and in UNIFI placebo non-responders (padj [type=response_pathway; source=ANALYSIS:treatment; arms.placebo (UNIFI).padj=0.00608]), consistent with general severity.

JAK-STAT activity is associated with non-response to ustekinumab (BH padj [type=response_pathway; source=ANALYSIS:treatment; arms.ustekinumab.padj=0.0124]) but not to golimumab (padj [type=response_pathway; source=ANALYSIS:treatment; arms.golimumab.padj=0.204]).

TGFb activity is associated with non-response to ustekinumab (BH padj [type=response_pathway; source=ANALYSIS:treatment; arms.ustekinumab.padj=0.000493]) but not to golimumab (padj [type=response_pathway; source=ANALYSIS:treatment; arms.golimumab.padj=0.348]); UNIFI placebo is also significant, so a severity component is likely.

OSM is higher at baseline in ustekinumab non-responders (BH padj [gene=OSM; type=treatment_response; source=ANALYSIS:treatment; arms.ustekinumab.padj=0.0000264]), but the drug-vs-placebo interaction is null (padj [gene=OSM; type=treatment_response; source=ANALYSIS:treatment; interaction.ustekinumab.padj=0.971]) and the UNIFI placebo difference has the same direction (padj [gene=OSM; type=treatment_response; source=ANALYSIS:treatment; arms.placebo (UNIFI).padj=0.116]). It marks severity rather than a ustekinumab-specific mechanism; no other drug arm survives correction.

TREM1 is higher in ustekinumab non-responders (BH padj [gene=TREM1; type=treatment_response; source=ANALYSIS:treatment; arms.ustekinumab.padj=0.0000474]) but also in UNIFI placebo non-responders (padj [gene=TREM1; type=treatment_response; source=ANALYSIS:treatment; arms.placebo (UNIFI).padj=0.0234]), so it reflects severity; golimumab, infliximab and vedolizumab arms do not survive correction.

IL11 shows the strongest ustekinumab association among the genes tested (BH padj [gene=IL11; type=treatment_response; source=ANALYSIS:treatment; arms.ustekinumab.padj=3.68e-8]), but UNIFI placebo non-responders also differ (padj [gene=IL11; type=treatment_response; source=ANALYSIS:treatment; arms.placebo (UNIFI).padj=0.0133]) and the interaction test is not significant, so it is a severity marker rather than a drug-specific one.

IL23A baseline expression is not associated with ustekinumab response (BH padj [gene=IL23A; type=treatment_response; source=ANALYSIS:treatment; arms.ustekinumab.padj=0.977]); nothing survives correction in any arm, so baseline target expression does not stratify response.

ITGB7 baseline expression is not associated with vedolizumab response (BH padj [gene=ITGB7; type=treatment_response; source=ANALYSIS:treatment; arms.vedolizumab.padj=0.995]); no arm survives correction.

CXCR2, the top convergence candidate with several clinical-stage antagonists, is higher in ustekinumab non-responders (BH padj [gene=CXCR2; type=treatment_response; source=ANALYSIS:treatment; arms.ustekinumab.padj=9.69e-6]) but also in UNIFI placebo non-responders (padj [gene=CXCR2; type=treatment_response; source=ANALYSIS:treatment; arms.placebo (UNIFI).padj=0.0126]); this is a neutrophil-axis severity marker, not a drug-specific mechanism.

CXCL8 is higher in ustekinumab non-responders (BH padj [gene=CXCL8; type=treatment_response; source=ANALYSIS:treatment; arms.ustekinumab.padj=0.000102]), but the drug-vs-placebo interaction is null (padj [gene=CXCL8; type=treatment_response; source=ANALYSIS:treatment; interaction.ustekinumab.padj=0.973]); it marks severity.

LAX1 is the strongest first-in-class discovery candidate but is only partly composition-independent, retaining a small share of its signal after composition adjustment ([gene=LAX1; type=discovery_profile; source=ANALYSIS:discovery; retained=0.2299754066732223]); plasma cells contribute the largest share of transcripts in inflamed mucosa ([gene=LAX1; type=sc_summary; source=DATASET:SCP259; top_clusters_inflamed.0.share=0.433]), so the increase largely reflects immune infiltration. The two datasets disagree on lineage (T/NK vs plasma).

XKR9 is an epithelial-intrinsic candidate with most signal retained after composition adjustment ([gene=XKR9; type=discovery_profile; source=ANALYSIS:discovery; retained=0.7976121951555432]), but it is up in only a few cohorts ([gene=XKR9; type=discovery_profile; source=ANALYSIS:discovery; cohorts_up=2]) and its lineage is not replicated in the second dataset; replication is the missing piece.

ADGRG3 passes the screen (antibody and small-molecule tractable) but neutrophils make most of its transcripts in inflamed mucosa ([gene=ADGRG3; type=sc_summary; source=DATASET:SCP259; neutrophil_share_inflamed=0.906]); it is a neutrophil infiltration marker rather than a tissue-intrinsic target.

CHRDL2 is stromal (inflammatory fibroblasts) with the lineage replicated in a second dataset ([gene=CHRDL2; type=sc_summary; source=DATASET:SCP259; dominant_lineage_share=0.939]), but only a minority of its signal is retained after composition adjustment and vital-organ RNA is the highest among the screened candidates ([gene=CHRDL2; type=discovery_profile; source=ANALYSIS:discovery; vital_max_ntpm=42.6]), which is a safety question.

caveats: Non-responder groups are small for infliximab, golimumab and vedolizumab (as few as 8 to 32 patients per group), so absence of significance there is weak evidence of absence.
UNIFI non-responders far outnumber responders, and the PURSUIT placebo arm is small; placebo comparisons are underpowered.
Associations with baseline expression are not predictions; no gene shows a significant drug-vs-placebo interaction.
Discovery candidates rely on bulk meta-analysis plus single-cell composition; none has functional or genetic validation in this data, and neutrophils are absent from the Smillie dataset.
Wording 'minority' and 'small share' for retained fractions refers to the stated retained values in the discovery profile.
